method: labeled uniformly resolvable design on 12 points with 6 groups of 2, Z_2 labels, block sizes [3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4] (z3 seed 113, labeled2.py), expanded by 2 (Shen / Schuster 2009 Thm 2.2), the expanded groups of 4 as one more week; chosen among several such designs for its lanes (altlanes.py); lane pairs by simulated annealing (lanes.c), positions by de Werra colouring (tools/positions.py)
